quotes.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden Mcdaniels on the Timberwolves' loss to the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: they just came out they played well they made shots and they just beat us

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Look at Chicago as a struggling team and maybe take it a little lightly?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
text_blocks.text: No, I mean they just came out they played well they made shots and they just beat us to be honest. They just played better than us.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the loss to Chicago: They just came out they played well they made shots and they just beat us to be honest. They just played better than us.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels discusses the Timberwolves' loss to the Chicago Bulls after the game.

quotes.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden Mcdaniels on the need for early game intensity
quotes.excerpt: we just got to do it from the start of the game

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: When that isn't there from the beginning of the game, is that something that's hard to retap into midway through?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
text_blocks.text: No, we just got to do it from the start of the game. We know we can, we did it the games before, so it's just a refresh thing to know that we got to play like that all game, every game.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels says the Timberwolves need to bring intensity from the start of the game every single night.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels explains the team's need to maintain intensity from the beginning of the game.

quotes.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden Mcdaniels on his need to play more aggressively
quotes.excerpt: I just got to be more aggressive during the game for real.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: When you guys need a little bit more offense from you in games, what areas are you trying to assert yourself more to get more shots?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
text_blocks.text: I don't know, I just got to be more aggressive during the game for real. That's pretty much it.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his offensive role: I just got to be more aggressive during the game for real.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels addresses a question about his personal need to be more aggressive offensively.

quotes.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden Mcdaniels on prioritizing defense over offensive reliance
quotes.excerpt: we should always be defense first

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Do you think it's a little bit risky to rely on the fact that you know how good your offense can be that takes away from relying on the defense?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden Mcdaniels
text_blocks.text: No, I feel like we should always be defense first. Just know that defense is going to help us win games, even if our shots are off, that we can fall back to our defense and help us have our defense create easy offense for us.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels emphasizes the Timberwolves identity: I feel like we should always be defense first. Defense is going to help us win games.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels explains why the team should prioritize defense over relying on their offensive output.
